## 🤖 PR Review (Round 2) **Branch:** `feat/remote-acpx-gemini-phases-2-4` → `main` **Round:** 2 | **Updated:** 2026-05-05 (re-review after resolver commit `ab4f026`) **Reviewer:** claude-opus-4-7 via pr-review-toolkit (all 6 agents) + Gemini Code Assist --- ### 📊 Summary | Category | Total | Fixed | Remaining | |----------|-------|-------|-----------| | 🔴 Critical | 0 | 0 | 0 | | 🟡 Important | 7 | 3 | 4 (1 regressed in `ab4f026`, 1 net-new in round 2, 2 deferred) | | 💡 Suggestions | 13 | 1 | 12 (4 net-new in round 2; 8 deferred from round 1) | **Status:** ⚠️ **Needs attention** — round-1 fixes hold for Important #3/#4/#5, but Important #2 regressed: the resolver replaced one piece of misleading documentation with another (referencing a tool that doesn't exist + claiming a code path that isn't wired). Recommend a one-line follow-up fix before merge. --- ### 🔄 Round 2 Highlights - **3 round-1 fixes verified** (#3 empty-string guard, #4 defaultAgent test, #5 non-model test) — code, comments, and tests all hold up under independent re-review. - **1 round-1 fix regressed** (#2): the rewritten `tool.ts` description now references `manage_agent` (no such tool exists; the actual tool is `coding_agent_add`) AND claims a roster-model path that is non-functional (`resolveAgentById` drops the `model` field; it never reaches `ensureSession`). Two-layer error introduced by the round-1 resolver. Detailed below. - **2 deferred items remain deferred** as agreed (#1 cross-repo dedup, #6 log.warn). - **1 net-new important** (#7): the silent-drop contract is broader than `model` — empty-string values for `approval_policy` / `system_prompt` / `timeout` would still silently pass through. Round-1 silent-failure-hunter focused on the `model` site; round 2 widened the scope. Recommend deferring to the same backlog as #6. - **No critical issues** introduced by `ab4f026`. The empty-string guard placement, the new tests, and the comment block at `runtime.ts:49-58` are correct and minimal. --- ### 🟡 Important Issues
1. ⏭️ Deferred — Cross-repo duplication: GEMINI_MODEL_ALIASES has no single source of truth **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/runtime.ts:49-58` (and upstream `openclaw/extensions/google/cli-backend.ts:7-11`) **Decision (round 1, unchanged):** Deferred to a separate upstream/openclaw follow-up. Round-2 type-design-analyzer confirms the comment-as-invariant is a known, tracked smell — the right fix is the SDK export, not a workaround here.
2. ⚠️ Regressed — [Gemini] run_coder agent description is still misleading after round-1 resolver **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/tool.ts:101-106` **Current text (post-`ab4f026`):** > *"…If omitted, uses the variant from the agentId roster entry (if set), otherwise the plugin default. Per-call model overrides aren't accepted here — set the model on the roster entry via `manage_agent` (Gemini short aliases 'pro' / 'flash' / 'flash-lite' work there)."* **Two regressions in the replacement text** (independently flagged by code-reviewer + comment-analyzer): 1. **Tool name does not exist.** Verified via `grep manage_agent`: only match is the description string itself. The actual roster-mutation tool is `coding_agent_add` (`agent-tools.ts:44`). An LLM following this hint will hallucinate-call `manage_agent` and fail. 2. **Roster-model claim is vacuous.** Even with the correct tool name, the model never flows through: - `resolveAgentById` (`agent-roster.ts:49-62`) returns only `{ cwd, agent }` — `model` is dropped. - `tool.ts:138-141, 163-166` only read `cwd` / `agent` from the roster result and pass `{ agent, cwd }` to `sessionMgr.getOrCreate`. - `runtime.ensureSession`'s `if (input.model)` branch is therefore never reached via the `run_coder` path. So the description promises a feature ("aliases work there") that the call chain silently swallows. Round-1 traded one misleading sentence for a new misleading sentence about a different non-feature. **Recommended fix (smallest possible):** drop the trailing "Per-call model overrides…" sentence entirely. Restore the description to its pre-PR form (just the three lines about variant resolution), making no claim about how to set the model. This is a one-line edit that resolves both regressions and reverts to known-truthful operator-facing docs. ```ts description: "ACP agent variant (e.g. 'claude', 'codex', 'gemini'). " + "Overrides the variant resolved from agentId. " + "If omitted, uses the variant from the agentId roster entry (if set), otherwise the plugin default.", ``` **Optional follow-up (separate PR):** wire `entry.model` through `resolveAgentById` → `getOrCreate` → `ensureSession` so the roster-model path actually works, then add a description that points at `coding_agent_add` truthfully.
3. ✅ Fixed — Empty-string guard on setConfigOption **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/runtime.ts:443-448` **Round-2 verdict:** Correct placement (after `decodeHandle` so invalid handles still throw, before the dispatch so empty values never land in cache). Scope-limited to `model` is the right call — `system_prompt` / `approval_policy` may have legitimate clear semantics. `!input.value` is safe for strings (only `""` is falsy among strings; `"0"` is truthy). New test `ignores empty-string model on setConfigOption` does verify the guard prevents `setSessionOption` from firing — assertion is real, not vacuous (verified by tracing through `runtime.ts:208-210, 358-360, 448`).
4. ✅ Fixed — Test for defaultAgent resolution path **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/runtime.test.ts` **Round-2 verdict:** Test correctly exercises the `input.agent || this.config.defaultAgent` branch at `runtime.ts:200`. Minor nit (non-blocking): `input.agent` is technically required by `AcpRuntimeEnsureInput` upstream, but vitest transpiles without strict type-check — would benefit from an `as AcpRuntimeEnsureInput` cast if the repo ever enables strict tsc on extensions.
5. ✅ Fixed — Test for non-model keys regression on Gemini sessions **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/runtime.test.ts` **Round-2 verdict:** Well-targeted. The deliberate alias-collision (`approval_policy: "flash"`) catches a regression where someone broadens the normalization branch to all keys. Exactly the right kind of test.
6. ⏭️ Deferred — Pass-through-on-unknown loses error locality **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/runtime.ts:60-67` **Decision (round 1, unchanged):** Deferred. Round-2 type-design-analyzer concurs the heuristic (`startsWith("gemini-")`) is fragile against future model id schemes; better fix waits for the cross-repo dedup.
7. ⏭️ Deferred (net-new in round 2) — Silent-drop contract extends beyond model **File:** `image-extensions/remote-acpx/src/runtime.ts:208, 448` **Net-new observation:** Round-1 reviewers focused on `model`. Round-2 silent-failure-hunter widened the lens: both `ensureSession` (line 208 `if (input.model)`) and `setConfigOption` (line 448) silently drop empty values without any `log.warn`/`log.debug`. The new guard is *consistent with* the existing silent contract but compounds the debt — operator who types `--model ""` intending to "unset" gets no feedback and the prior cached value persists. For non-`model` keys (`approval_policy`, `system_prompt`, `timeout`), empty values still flow through unchecked. **Decision:** Defer alongside #6. The right fix is a unified observability pass over the config-option capability surface (add `log.warn` at both drop sites; consider whether non-`model` keys should also reject empty values), not a one-off addition in this PR. Recording here so it doesn't get lost.
--- ### 💡 Suggestions
View 13 suggestions (1 addressed, 12 deferred) | # | Suggestion | File:Line | Status | Source | |---|------------|-----------|--------|--------| | 1 | Tighten table with `as const satisfies Record`; export `GeminiModelAlias`. | `runtime.ts:53` | ⏭️ Deferred | Round 1 | | 2 | Narrow `agent` to open-enum: `"claude" \| "codex" \| "gemini" \| (string & {})`. | `runtime.ts:65` | ⏭️ Deferred | Round 1 | | 3 | Don't export `normalizeGeminiModel` — make module-private. | `runtime.ts:60` | ⏭️ Deferred | Round 1 | | 4 | Replace `void iter[Symbol.asyncIterator]().next() + setTimeout(0)` with `await iter.next()`. | `runtime.test.ts` (8 sites now) | ⏭️ Deferred (worse spot to defer now — 8 sites) | Round 1 | | 5 | Tighten the upstream-sync comment specifying exactly what to compare. | `runtime.ts:49-58` | ✅ Addressed in `ab4f026` | Round 1 | | 6 | Rephrase to "neither the node-host turn handler nor `gemini --acp` resolves these short names…" | `runtime.ts:50` | ✅ Addressed in `ab4f026` | Round 1 | | 7 | SKILL.md hardcodes full preview ids; reference the runtime constant instead. | `skills/remote-acp-router/SKILL.md:64-72` | ⏭️ Deferred | Round 1 | | 8 | Add a one-liner above the two normalize call sites explaining why both exist. | `runtime.ts` near 206 / 442 | ⏭️ Deferred | Round 1 | | 9 | Add reverse-direction tests: `gemini → claude` and `gemini → gemini` with different cwd. | `session-manager.test.ts:128` | ⏭️ Deferred | Round 1 | | **10** | **Extract test helper** — the iter+setTimeout+find pattern is now duplicated across 8 sites in `runtime.test.ts`. A small `runTurnAndGetPayload(runtime, handle)` helper would collapse ~10 lines per test to ~2 and naturally absorb the deferred Sug #4 swap. | `runtime.test.ts` | ⏭️ Deferred | **Round 2 net-new** | | **11** | **Trim 7-line comment block** to the original 4-line form; drop "tracked as follow-up work" (no concrete handle for future readers) or replace with a `TODO(remote-acpx):` tag for greppability. | `runtime.ts:49-58` | ⏭️ Deferred | **Round 2 net-new** | | **12** | **Tighten "most CLIs"** in the new guard comment to specifically name the variant CLIs (claude/codex/gemini) — current wording is vague. | `runtime.ts:443-447` | ⏭️ Deferred | **Round 2 net-new** | | **13** | **`agent-tools.ts:58-60` description subtle inaccuracy**: claims aliases "are normalized to full Gemini model ids" — but normalization happens in `runtime.ts`, not in `coding_agent_add` itself; the roster file may store the short alias verbatim. Tighten to "are accepted here and normalized at session start; the roster file may store the short alias verbatim." | `agent-tools.ts:58-60` | ⏭️ Deferred | **Round 2 net-new** |
--- ### ✨ Strengths (round 2 verified) - **Round-1 fixes hold under re-review.** The empty-string guard, the two new tests, and the alias-table comment block are all correct and minimal. Resolver commit did not introduce critical or important regressions in code or tests — only in operator-facing docs (#2). - **Test design improving**: round-2 pr-test-analyzer specifically calls out the deliberate alias-collision in the non-`model`-keys test as "exactly the right kind of test." The assertion strengths in tests 1 and 2 are tight; test 3 could be `toEqual({})` instead of `not.toHaveProperty("model")` for marginally stronger coverage but is non-vacuous. - **Comment quality improving**: the new guard comment at `runtime.ts:443-447` is called out by comment-analyzer as a textbook why-comment (names failure mode + semantic mismatch + symmetry preserved). - **Cross-reference verification**: round-2 comment-analyzer independently verified the alias-table claim against `openclaw/src/node-host/invoke-acp.ts:95-96` (passes `--model` raw, no normalization). Comment is factually accurate. --- ### 📋 Type Design Ratings (unchanged from round 1) | Type | Encap. | Express. | Useful. | Enforce. | Overall | |------|--------|----------|---------|----------|---------| | `GEMINI_MODEL_ALIASES` / `normalizeGeminiModel` / `normalizeModelForAgent` | 7/10 | 4/10 | 8/10 | 9/10 | **7/10** | Round-2 confirmed: resolver commit altered no types or signatures. The 7-line comment is "naming a missing abstraction rather than hiding it" — appropriate interim shape given the dedup is deferred. --- ### 🎯 Action Plan (round 2) **Before Merge:** - [ ] **Fix the regressed Important #2** — drop the trailing "Per-call model overrides…" sentence in `tool.ts:104-105`; restore description to pre-misleading form (one-line edit). Highest-priority remaining item. - [x] All other round-1 "Before Merge" items remain checked. **Optionally Before Merge** (judgment call): - [ ] Apply Suggestion #10 — extract `runTurnAndGetPayload` helper. Round-2 simplifier and test-analyzer both flagged this as load-bearing now (8 sites). Resolves the deferred Sug #4 swap as a side effect. **After Merge (Backlog):** - [ ] Upstream PR: export `GEMINI_MODEL_ALIASES` from openclaw plugin SDK (Important #1 + unblocks #6 + #7). - [ ] Wire roster `model` field through `resolveAgentById` → `getOrCreate` → `ensureSession` (separate feature; resolves the underlying gap that motivated the regression in Important #2 and would let `coding_agent_add` actually accept the alias). - [ ] Type tightening: `as const satisfies` + open-enum agent type (Suggestions #1, #2, #3). - [ ] Comment polish: trim 7-line block (Sug #11), tighten "most CLIs" (Sug #12), correct `agent-tools.ts` "are normalized" claim (Sug #13). - [ ] SKILL.md decouple from full-id list (Suggestion #7). - [ ] Test symmetry: reverse-direction variant switch (Suggestion #9). - [ ] Observability: add `log.warn` at the two empty-value drop sites + decide whether non-`model` keys should also reject empties (Important #6 + #7). --- Generated by pr-review-and-document skill | Round 2 | Agents: code-reviewer · pr-test-analyzer · silent-failure-hunter · type-design-analyzer · comment-analyzer · code-simplifier | Gemini Code Assist integrated 2026-05-05 (ids 3188514889, 3188514894) | Resolver commit: `ab4f026`
